newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends little changed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends little changed in thin trade.

text.p: PALM FUTURES - The market remained rangebound and closed little changed in the absence of interest and fresh leads. Market awaiting March export data. Trading expected to remain quiet ahead of Good Friday and Easter holidays. June futures range seen at between 1,230 and 1,250.
PALM PHYSICAL - Also barely changed on continued thin participation.
June futures closed one ringgit higher at 1,241 ringgit ($500) a tonne.
Among physicals Apr (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,285 ringgit against bids of 1,282.50, after trading at 1,280 and 1,282.50.
Apr (central) saw offers at 1,270 against bids of 1,265 and Apr (north) at 1,257.50 against 1,247.50.
May south) was offered at 1,277.50 with bids at 1,270 with and May (central) at 1,267.50 against 1,260.
Among refined products, Apr RBD palm oil was offered at $542.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, May $537.50, June at $535 and July/Aug/Sep at $532.50. May was traded at $532.50.
Apr RBD palm olein saw offers at $580, May at $572.50, Jun at $570 and July/Aug/Sep at 562.50. Apr was traded at $575 and $577.50, and May at $567.50.
Apr RBD palm stearin was offered at $437.50 and Apr/May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $295.
